training_method.method: isolated PyTorch quantization-aware training smoke test
training_method.dataset: 4 fixed, generic synthetic sentences; not a representative language dataset
training_method.teacher_model: same pretrained model as the student before compression
training_method.checkpoint_verification: Packed tensors saved, read back with weights_only=True; OPT model separately reloaded from packed weights and produced finite logits.

limitations: Only two training steps on a tiny synthetic sample; not evidence of usefulness, accuracy, or generalization.
The 0.55 BPW value is a target for converted linear layers, NOT a measured whole-model bits-per-weight or achieved total compression ratio.
Checkpoint file sizes include uncompressed portions and framework metadata; not a measure of full-model compressed runtime memory.
The vendor training entry point assumes BF16 and DeepSpeed; this experiment used a separate FP32 training runner due to Pascal GPU restrictions.
The stock inference loader failed during meta-device model construction. CPU-first loading and GPU inference of packed weights passed.
This package excludes model checkpoints and original Samsung source code.
No Strata, Ollama, or other production inference integration was performed.
